news.title: The banned World Cup kit that’s now on sale in ‘rarest’ bargain this year
news.lede: For kit collectors, the best part of the year actually happens several months after the tournament because that is when the best kits from the tournament are massively reduced. While big-name kit makers have not announced their Black Friday and Christmas deals, one seller has gone early and dropped the price of some of the best international kit launches of the year. A £35 discount on one of the rarest kits of the year is the highlight of the sale at UK Soccer Shop. It is highly unlikely Haiti kits will be widely available in the coming years and that means now is the best time to buy.

news.title: ‘An absolute afterthought’: the story of the Nigeria women’s team’s fall from grace
news.lede: The Super Falcons won’t be at the World Cup and with the prize money going up, they risk being left even further behind. It was a historic result in Casablanca – but not in a good way. Nigeria’s 2-1 defeat against South Africa in a playoff in August meant that the Super Falcons are missing out on the World Cup for the first time. It is a crushing blow for the most decorated national side in Africa across both men and women, one that has won no fewer than 10 Wafcon titles.

news.title: Football: Asian Cup postponed to Dec. 2027 amid Saudi unrest
news.lede: TOKYO - The Asian Football Confederation announced Tuesday the Asian Cup originally scheduled for early next year in Saudi Arabia has been postponed and will start instead in December 2027. A number of sporting events and international conferences in the region have been postponed or canceled in recent weeks amid the ongoing unrest in Saudi Arabia, which has come under attack by Yemen's Houthi group. The continental tournament was set to be held between Jan. 7 and Feb. 5 next year but has been pushed back to kick off on Dec. 23 and end on Jan. 21, 2028, the AFC said. "The Organizing Committee for AFC Asian Cup approved to reschedule the flagship national team tournament in light of the current exceptional circumstances arising from developments in the region," its statement read.

news.title: Asian Cup delay means more uncertainty for Korean football
news.lede: Korean national football team interim head coach Robert Moreno looks on prior to an international friendly match between Korea and Uzbekistan at Yongin Mireu Stadium in Yongin, Gyeonggi Province, Oct. Yonhap The postponement of the Asian Cup from January to December 2027 is not a surprise, but it does create issues for Korean football, adding more uncertainty to the national team. The Asian Football Confederation (AFC) made the announcement on Tuesday. Saudi Arabia, the host nation, has come under attack from the Yemen-based Houthis.

news.title: 'I don't have respect for him' - Shakhtar Donetsk chief Darijo Srna slams FIFA president Gianni Infantino over lack of support for Ukrainian clubs
news.lede: Shakhtar Donetsk sporting director Darijo Srna has launched a scathing attack on FIFA president Gianni Infantino over the governing body's treatment of Ukrainian football during the ongoing war. The former Croatia captain accused world football's leaders of failing to protect domestic teams and challenged the chief to visit the country himself. news.title: Asian Cup postponed in wake of attacks on Saudi Arabia
news.lede: Aston Villa will have goalkeeper Zion Suzuki more available this season because of the rescheduling of the Asian Cup. The 2027 Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia has been postponed because of a series of deadly attacks on the host country. The 24-team tournament was scheduled to take place from 7 January to 5 February but has been rescheduled to run from 23 December, 2027 to 21 January, 2028. In October, a missile attack by Yemen's Houthi movement on Riyadh's airport killed 13 people and wounded more than 300.

news.title: Saudi Arabia conflict postpones Socceroos’ Asian Cup tilt
news.lede: The Socceroos′ Asian Cup campaign has been postponed due to conflict in the Middle East. The tournament was due to take place in Saudi Arabia from January to February but now faces an 11-month postponement. Socceroos players pose before the World Cup match against Egypt. The new dates for the Asian Cup are December 23, 2027, to January 21, 2028.

news.title: India vs New Zealand football: Chris Wood headlines All Whites squad for November friendlies
news.lede: Chennai New Zealand and Nottingham Forest star Chris Wood will headlined the squad as the All Whites announced its squad for the November friendlies against India, later this month. Wood had a breakthrough season at Forest in the 2024-25 season, scoring 20 goals across all competitions, and led New Zealand in the FIFA World Cup, earlier this year. He assisted twice against Iran, though the team exited the tournament in the group stage. New Zealand will end 2026 with two games against India starting at Go Media Stadium in Tāmaki Makaurau, Auckland on November 12 before playing the first-ever international football match at One New Zealand Stadium in Ōtautahi, Christchurch three days later.
